title_or_table: County Business Patterns, United States, NAICS 511110 (newspaper publishers)
observation_period: Annual, 1998 to 2023; employees counted in the pay period including March 12
universe_or_base: Establishments with paid employees classed in NAICS 511110
vintage: CBP annual releases 1998 to 2023 (2023 released in 2025), read through the data API
qualification: County Business Patterns counts paid employees in mid-March at establishments classed as newspaper publishers (print and online); freelancers, the self-employed and newsrooms classed in other industries are not counted. NAICS revisions in 2002, 2007, 2012 and 2017 kept this code and its title; the API serves 2023 under the 2017 code list

naics_vintage.description: NAICS edition the year uses in the API

printed_source_line: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, County Business Patterns, newspaper publishers (NAICS 511110), 1998 to 2023, United States. Retrieved November 11, 2026. Establishments with paid employees only; employees counted in mid-March.
